source_text: Can we do a test to see if the Lean LSP  is of any use in the topology loop?

fragments.text: Can we do a test to see if the Lean LSP  is of any use in the topology loop?

reply_text:
Checking first that a Codex seat can use the LSP tools at all, through a per-run config override that leaves the shared `~/.codex/config.toml` alone.Yes. The main hurdle is cleared: a Codex seat can use the LSP tools. In a test run, gpt-5.6-sol called `lean_goal` on an apm-lean file and returned the right goal. That setup passes the MCP server as per-run `-c` options, so the shared `~/.codex/config.toml` isn't touched.

**Proposed test:** an A/B run on real topology work, with a seat that has the LSP tools against one that doesn't.
- **Tasks:** the three re-routed problems queued for topo1: t91J06, t95J02 and t99J04. Each is "follow reroute steps 1–4 and remove one `sorry`", with a compiled probe already in hand.
- **Arms:** each task goes to two fresh gpt-5.6-sol runs with the same prompt and the same starting file. One arm also gets lean-lsp-mcp; the remote search tools stay off so no queries leave Zone.
- **Isolation:** each run works on its own copy of the file, so neither touches the repo or topo1's rows. All six run at the same time in `futon-agents.slice`, with a 60-minute cap each.
- **Measured from each run's JSON log:**
  - `sorry`s removed (does the copy compile with fewer `sorry`s?)
  - wall time and tokens
  - how many whole-file compiles it ran
  - how many LSP calls it made, and which ones
- **Afterwards:** any copy that removes its `sorry` goes through topo1's normal review, so successful work isn't thrown away.

**Limits:** three pairs will show a large difference, such as the LSP arm closing twice as often or using half the tokens. It won't settle a small one. If the result is unclear, a second round on the solve loop's stalled problems would add pairs cheaply.

**Cost:** six substantial Codex runs, roughly equal to six hard loop attempts. I'll record your weekly Codex percentage before and after, so you have the exact figure.

Shall I run it?
